implementation_decisions.change: Add CampaignComposition as a construction-only bundle/factory for ChallengeCampaignCatalog, ChallengeProjectionService, SuperCampaignCatalog, SuperCampaignProjectionService, SuperCampaignAccessPolicy and EliteCampaignUnlockCoordinator.
implementation_decisions.reason: RequestServices and PlayerMaintenanceServices previously constructed overlapping Super graphs independently while WorldRepository constructed Challenge collaborators through hidden fallbacks.

implementation_decisions.change: RequestServices and PlayerMaintenanceServices now consume the same CampaignComposition.build() contract and expose aliases to the same existing collaborator types.
implementation_decisions.reason: Reduce constructor drift without merging domain authorities.

implementation_decisions.change: Production roots pass explicit Challenge/Super collaborators into WorldRepository with strict_campaign_collaborators=True.
implementation_decisions.reason: Fail fast if a live root omits or mixes canonical Campaign collaborators instead of silently creating a parallel graph.

implementation_decisions.change: WorldRepository legacy fallback construction remains available only when strict mode is not requested, preserving direct compatibility/tool callers during the strangler migration.
implementation_decisions.reason: Facade-preserving incremental migration; no broad rewrite.

identity_invariants: SuperCampaignProjectionService and SuperCampaignAccessPolicy share the injected SuperCampaignCatalog.
SuperCampaignAccessPolicy and EliteCampaignUnlockCoordinator share one FunctionStateRepository.
Request graph Super projection/coordinator share the request UnitOfWork; maintenance graph uses None for both.
WorldRepository receives the exact same Challenge/Super collaborator objects as the root.
preserved_authorities: WorldRepository public facade and all existing Campaign use-case methods
deliberately_not_done: No MID113/MID114 CampaignBattleService extraction yet; they must move together in a later byte-equivalent strangler step.
No MID117 CampaignSweepService extraction yet; schedule with Campaign EXP/Mana reconciliation.
No MID112 reconcile-vs-serialization split yet; retain accepted Pass128.2 wire self-heal until a dedicated safe pass.
No merge of the four Super modules.
No orphan historical runtime module removal in this pass.
